platform.name: Know Your Dept (KYD)
platform.description: The official student and faculty portal for department resources, notes, PYQs, faculty directory, events, and student communities.

questions.q: How can I access and download lecture notes?
questions.a: Navigate to the Notes section from the resources page (/notes). You can browse subjects by Year (1st to 4th Year) and click the Download button on any note to open and download the PDF document directly in your browser.

questions.q: What sample PDF notes are available?
questions.a:
Sample downloadable PDF notes include:
- Data Structures & Algorithms (Trees, Graphs, DP)
- Operating Systems (Process Management, Deadlocks & Memory)
- Machine Learning (Neural Networks & SVM Guide)
- DBMS (SQL Queries, Normalization & ACID Properties)
- Mathematics I (Calculus & Linear Algebra Cheatsheet)
- Cybersecurity (Ethical Hacking & Network Defense).

questions.q: Can students upload their own notes?
questions.a: Yes! Click on 'Upload Note' on the Notes page to upload your study files (.pdf, .docx, .txt).

questions.q: Where can I find and download PYQ papers?
questions.a: Visit the PYQs section (/pyqs). You can view and download Midterm and Final exam PDF question papers across 2022, 2023, and 2024.

questions.q: Which exam papers are available for download?
questions.a:
Available downloadable question papers include:
- YCS 3001 Data Structures Midterm Exam (2024)
- YCS 3001 Data Structures Final Exam (2023)
- YCS 5001 Operating Systems Final Exam (2023)
- YCS 7001 Machine Learning Midterm Exam (2023)
- YMA 1001 Mathematics I End Semester Exam (2022).

questions.q: How do I contact my department professors?
questions.a: Go to the Teachers section (/teachers). You can view teacher profiles, emails, office room numbers, and research domains.

questions.q: How do I register or participate in department events?
questions.a: Visit the Events page (/events), click on any event card to view full schedule details, and click 'View Details' to register.

questions.q: What student communities exist in KYD?
questions.a:
Active student communities include:
- CodeCraft Hub (Coding, Open-source & Hackathons - 148 members)
- Robotics & AI Society (Autonomous Robots, Vision & IoT - 112 members)
- CyberSec Alliance (Penetration testing & CTFs - 94 members)
- Cloud & DevOps Guild (Docker, K8s & AWS Cloud - 76 members)
- UI/UX & Frontend Designers (Figma, Animations & Design Systems - 83 members).

questions.q: How do I join or create a community?
questions.a: Go to the Communities page (/communities). You can apply to join any existing club with the 'Apply to Join' button or click '+ Create a Community' to start your own.

questions.q: What is the mandatory attendance requirement?
questions.a: A minimum of 75% attendance in theory and practical classes is required to be eligible for end-semester examinations.

questions.q: What are the department lab timings?
questions.a: Computer & Research Labs are open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

questions.q: Who do I contact for website or account issues?
questions.a: You can reach out to support@jisuniversity.edu or visit the Department Admin Office (Floor 9, Room 1001).
